title: Multi-currency wallet features
summary: This document describes Multi-currency wallet support for the account (available: Yes), allowing balances in up to 30 foreign currencies. Currency conversions use the interbank rate plus a 0.5% markup, including for EveryonePay transfers up to $5,000 per day.
